recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: vintage BASIC games resurrected in modern C
massive robot armies clashing in a free open-source RTS revival
identity verification gathering at the AI gate
longest daylight under gray june fog over the bay
stutter-house pulses cutting through a quiet coding week
summer solstice with fleetwood mac on repeat

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Tap fragmented beat drops as gray fog rolls across a one-lane skyline — each stutter-house hit clears a patch of mist and reveals the pulse underneath.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap on off-grid beat fragments
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nail a 45-second drop sequence where every missed beat lets fog creep back in
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM stutters double, ghost notes appear between real hits, fog recovery accelerates
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon pulse bleeding through matte gray fog layers

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick tiny robot squads across a minimap to capture resource nodes before enemy swarms overwhelm your perimeter — one-screen total-annihilation micro skirmish.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: physics flick to deploy units at nodes
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one decisive 60-second battle where three well-placed flicks win or lose the map
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: enemy spawn waves widen, nodes decay faster, friendly units collide and scatter
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: green phosphor wireframe battlefield on black CRT

claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.concept: Drag paths between disconnected vintage terminals before rolling fog erases your lines — reconnect a lost BASIC mainframe network across a solstice-long afternoon.
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.mechanic: draw a path to link nodes
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.session_hook: link five terminals in under a minute; each successful chain unlocks a snippet of running code
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.escalation: fog patches spawn on existing routes, terminals drift apart, decoy nodes blink on
claude-opus-4-7-thinking-max.aesthetic: amber CRT phosphor with scanline drift

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe falling code snippets into the correct language lane — BASIC, C, shell — before the terminal buffer overflows on a dormant github week.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clear the buffer in 30 seconds; satisfying cascade when a full lane compiles
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fall speed increases, decoy languages and merged snippets appear, buffer shrinks
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: punch-card paper cutout with monospace ink stamps
